name: Satellite
summary: Orbiting satellite with a box body, antenna and solar-panel wings that floats in space; use for space and orbit scenes.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the body; floats, no ground

params.name: y
params.note: centre y of the body; the satellite floats around this point (it does not stand on y)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the satellite is about 500 px wide including the wings

params.name: anim
params.note: drift = slow float and gentle rotation

author: krakujs
